source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 4ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Θεόφιλος ο Ιερομάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives no year. The corpus holds thirteen other men of this name and not one of them is on 4 July or beheaded without a place: the nearest in kind, Theophilus (6 February), is a different day, and Theophilus the Myrrh-streamer on 8 July a different man with a monastery and a life. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
